question:
The given histogram shows the average percentage score of boys and girls in an examination during the years 2014-2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a74d9cb07c46572ee3e400ed3fc40154789617fcb057e91b1ef834e7c2f1b6.png] 

What is the ratio of the absolute difference in percentage scores of boys and girls in 2014 as compared to the absolute difference in their percentage scores in 2018?
solution:
**GIVEN :**

Percentage scores of boys and girls in the year 2014 -2018

**CALCULATION:**

In the year 2014

Percentage score of boys = 65

Percentage score of girls = 60 

⇒ Absolute difference = ( 65 - 60) = 5.

In the year 2018 

Percentage score of boys = 60

Percentage score of girls = 80 

⇒ Absolute difference = (80 - 60) = 20

⇒ Required ratio = 5 : 20 = 1 : 4.

**∴ Required absolute difference in percentage score is 1 : 4.**
